Simulate an LDL cholesterol trial dataset

Source: R/simulate-ldl.R
simulate_ldl.Rd

Returns simulated, analysis-ready LDL cholesterol data modelled on a published clinical trial. Every subject is made up. The data has one row per subject per scheduled visit, with no missing values, ready for the trial's mixed model for repeated measures (MMRM).

Usage

simulate_ldl(n, study = c("orion10", "odyssey_lt"))

Arguments

n

Number of subjects. The randomization ratio depends on the study. Subjects left over after the last full ratio block go to the active treatment.

study

The trial to model:

  • "orion10": ORION-10, inclisiran vs placebo (NCT03399370), randomized 1:1. The trial randomized 1,561. See vignette("orion10", package = "clinique").

  • "odyssey_lt": ODYSSEY LONG TERM, alirocumab vs placebo (NCT01507831), randomized 2:1. The trial randomized 2,341. See vignette("odyssey-lt", package = "clinique").

Value

A data frame with one row per subject per visit, sorted by subject and then visit. Every study has these columns:

  • subject_id: Subject identifier, such as "001-0001".

  • treatment: Factor with placebo as the reference level: "Placebo" and "Inclisiran" or "Alirocumab".

  • age: Age in years.

  • sex: "Male" or "Female".

  • race: "White", "Black" or "Other".

  • visit: Ordered factor: "Day 150" to "Day 540" for ORION-10, "Week 4" to "Week 52" for ODYSSEY LONG TERM.

  • day: Study day of the visit.

  • ldl_baseline: LDL at baseline, in mg/dL.

  • ldl: LDL at the visit, in mg/dL.

  • ldl_pct_change: Percent change in LDL from baseline.

ODYSSEY LONG TERM adds its randomization strata, which its analysis plan adjusts for:

  • hefh: Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, "Yes" or "No".

  • prior_mi_stroke: Prior heart attack or ischemic stroke, "Yes" or "No".

  • statin_intensity: "High" or "Low/moderate".

  • region: "North America", "Western Europe", "Eastern Europe" or "Rest of World".

Details

The baseline LDL, the mean percent change at each visit and the demographics follow the trial's published results. The mean percent changes follow the observed means, not the published estimates that account for missing values. Each study's vignette explains every number, its source and the assumptions.

The data is simulated. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by either trial's sponsor.

References

ORION-10 statistical analysis plan: https://cdn.clinicaltrials.gov/large-docs/70/NCT03399370/SAP_001.pdf

ORION-10 FDA statistical review: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2022/214012Orig1s000StatR.pdf

Ray KK, et al. Two Phase 3 Trials of Inclisiran in Patients with Elevated LDL Cholesterol. N Engl J Med 2020;382:1507-1519. doi:10.1056/NEJMoa1912387

ODYSSEY LONG TERM FDA statistical review: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2015/125559Orig1s000StatR.pdf

Robinson JG, et al. Efficacy and Safety of Alirocumab in Reducing Lipids and Cardiovascular Events. N Engl J Med 2015;372:1489-1499. Its statistical analysis plan is in the protocol supplement. doi:10.1056/NEJMoa1501031

Examples

set.seed(1)
ldl <- simulate_ldl(100)
head(ldl)
#>   subject_id treatment age    sex  race   visit day ldl_baseline       ldl
#> 1   001-0001   Placebo  70 Female White Day 150 150     89.60336  96.17405
#> 2   001-0001   Placebo  70 Female White Day 270 270     89.60336 119.41800
#> 3   001-0001   Placebo  70 Female White Day 330 330     89.60336 106.97133
#> 4   001-0001   Placebo  70 Female White Day 450 450     89.60336 119.43851
#> 5   001-0001   Placebo  70 Female White Day 510 510     89.60336 111.94626
#> 6   001-0001   Placebo  70 Female White Day 540 540     89.60336 115.37867
#>   ldl_pct_change
#> 1       7.333092
#> 2      33.274030
#> 3      19.383169
#> 4      33.296914
#> 5      24.935342
#> 6      28.766009

odyssey <- simulate_ldl(90, study = "odyssey_lt")
head(odyssey)
